test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Assuming that the data given in the statement are definitely true which of the following conclusions can be logically deducted from given statements.

Statement: The company has launched an AI chatbot to handle customer queries.

Conclusions:

I. The company wants to improve customer service.

II. The number of support staff will be reduced.
solution:
Given Statement:

The company has launched an AI chatbot to handle customer queries.

Now, analyzing the Conclusions:

Conclusion I: The company wants to improve customer service.

– Reasonable and logically inferred, as AI chatbots are generally introduced to improve efficiency and customer service.

– Hence, Conclusion I **follows**.

Conclusion II: The number of support staff will be reduced.

– No direct or necessary information is given in the statement to support staff reduction.

– Hence, Conclusion II does not follow.

So, only Conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
